novelty_flags.one_line: The core portrays Definition 3.14 as an erroneous replacement of actual changed rows by baseline path rows, but the cited paper first defines the compatibility linear system using the actual Δ^(k) rows and then explicitly proves that generic ranks equal its baseline-inverse rank test.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 907–908, Section 3.3.1, equations (20) and (23), Definition 3.14, Theorem 3.15 and proof
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines M_{G,G'}[j] and b_{G,G'}[j] from the actual intervention differences Δ^(k)=(I-Λ^(k))^{-1}-(I-Λ^(0))^{-1}; its proof of Theorem 3.15 then says the Definition 3.14 baseline-inverse ranks are the same generically after replacing each change λ^(k)_{k,i}-λ^(0)_{k,i} by λ^(0)_{k,i}.
The proceedings record confirms the cited ICML 2023 paper and its claim that one intervention per latent variable is sufficient for identifiability in its stated LCD setting.

The paper develops the latent-factor half-trek criterion as a sufficient criterion for rational identifiability of direct effects from observed covariance matrices, including polynomial-time verification under bounded latent-subset searches.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Withdraw the assertion that the published baseline-rank substitution is wrong unless the model is changed to a precisely stated non-generic or constrained intervention regime where the Theorem 3.15 rank-equivalence proof cannot apply; then prove the separation under that altered regime.

Recast the terminal-copy result as a combinatorial algorithm for the already-published soft-compatible class, and state exactly which min-cut and affine-support certificate gives a new complexity or constructivity advance over Definition 3.14 rather than calling it a correction.

Before advancing, complete the fork classification and exhibit one nontrivial bounded-width family whose positive-real branch certificates are checked directly against all covariance contexts; use it to substantiate the compiler's claimed bit bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise the terminal-row/mismatch kernel to align with the cited Theorem 3.15 or explicitly move to a model outside its genericity assumptions, then rerun novelty review before Stage 0.
